What non-expiry means on MTN

Every MTN bundle in the table above has no validity period. Buy 1GB today and use it over three months and nothing expires in between — the megabytes stay on the line until they are used. That is why MTN is the network people buy big bundles on: the 50GB bundle at GH₵220.00 (GH₵4.40 per GB) is the best per-GB price we sell on this network.

Payment goes through Valmont-Pay — MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money or card. We never see or store your MoMo PIN: you approve every charge on your own phone.

Delivery starts the moment payment confirms. Most bundles arrive within minutes; it depends on the network at the time. Every order gets a tracking reference and an SMS confirmation.

If a delivery fails we retry it automatically (up to three attempts) and refund it automatically if it still won't complete. Wrong numbers are not refundable — check the line before you pay.

You can buy for any number — yours, a family member's or a customer's. You do not have to be the account holder, and the site warns you if the prefix you typed belongs to a different network.

Which numbers are MTN?

In our number checker these prefixes belong to MTN: 024, 025, 026, 027, 054, 055, 056, 057, 059. Note that 026 is shared with AirtelTigo, 027 is shared with AirtelTigo — Ghana allows number portability, so a prefix is a good hint, not a guarantee. If the line you enter looks like another network we warn you before you pay, because a bundle sent to the wrong network will not deliver and wrong-number orders cannot be refunded. The full list is on our Ghana network prefixes page.

Questions people ask before buying

How much is MTN data?

MTN bundles run from GH₵6.00 for 1GB to GH₵220.00 for 50GB. The best per-GB price is 50GB at GH₵4.40 per GB. All 14 prices are in the table above and are the same prices checkout charges.

Does MTN data expire?

No. Every MTN bundle we sell is non-expiry — there is no validity period, so unused data stays on the line until it is used. Our Telecel and AirtelTigo bundles work differently: they are 60-day rollover.

How do I buy MTN data here?

Tap any bundle in the table (or the buy button), enter the MTN number that should receive the data, then pay with MTN MoMo, another Mobile Money wallet or card through Valmont-Pay. Delivery starts as soon as the payment confirms. You can also order by WhatsApp — send "hi" to +233 54 245 1578.

Can I buy MTN data for another number?

Yes. You can buy for any number — yours, a family member's or a customer's. You do not have to be the account holder, and the site warns you if the prefix you typed belongs to a different network.

What if the MTN bundle does not deliver?

If a delivery fails we retry it automatically (up to three attempts) and refund it automatically if it still won't complete. Wrong numbers are not refundable — check the line before you pay.

Which prefixes are MTN?

Our checker treats 024, 025, 026, 027, 054, 055, 056, 057, 059 as MTN numbers. Because of number portability a prefix is a hint, not a proof — see the full prefix list.
